request: Mirror the part according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part. Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one so they create one body.

actions.relational_constraint: Use the plane lying on the non-rounded end of the part as the mirror plane.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the non-rounded end of the part and resolve the plane located on that end, including whether it is an existing datum plane or a planar end face.

actions.operation: Merge the mirrored part with the existing part using a Boolean union
actions.target: The mirrored part created by the preceding action and the existing original part
actions.relational_constraint: The mirrored and existing parts must be joined into a single body.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the existing original body and the mirrored result, and verify that their geometry permits a single merged body.

intention: Produce one unified body from the original part and its mirrored copy.
